content.text:
All remaining errors are pre-existing in unrelated files. My changes type-check clean.

**Summary of changes:**

- [src/screens/room-media/hooks/useMediaTimeline.ts](src/screens/room-media/hooks/useMediaTimeline.ts) — dropped the aggressive "paginate until start" loop. Now loads one page (10 media items) on mount and exposes `loadMore`, `isLoadingMore`, `reachedEnd`.
- [src/screens/room/fragments/room-timeline/RoomTimeline.tsx](src/screens/room/fragments/room-timeline/RoomTimeline.tsx) — removed `useMediaTimeline` and the effect that populated `roomMediaItems`. Chat no longer triggers media pagination.
- [src/modules/timeline/jotai/atoms.ts](src/modules/timeline/jotai/atoms.ts) — replaced `roomMediaItems` with a `mediaTimelineStore` atom (items + loadMore + reachedEnd + isLoadingMore + roomId).
- [src/@types/timeline.d.ts](src/@types/timeline.d.ts) — added `MediaTimelineStore` type.
- [src/screens/room-media/fragments/media-gallery/MediaGallery.tsx](src/screens/room-media/fragments/media-gallery/MediaGallery.tsx) — publishes the live store to the atom while mounted; wires `loadMore` into `MediaList`.
- [src/screens/room-media/fragments/media-list/MediaList.tsx](src/screens/room-media/fragments/media-list/MediaList.tsx) — added `onEndReached` pagination + footer loader (otherwise the grid would only ever show the initial 10).
- [src/shared/components/media-viewer-modal/MediaViewerModal.tsx](src/shared/components/media-viewer-modal/MediaViewerModal.tsx) — reads from the live store when available; prepends a loader sentinel at index 0 while `!reachedEnd`; triggers `loadMore` when the loader scrolls into view; re-anchors the scroll position on the currently-viewed event after newer pages arrive.
- [ImageMessage.tsx](src/screens/room/fragments/image-message/ImageMessage.tsx) & [VideoMessage.tsx](src/screens/room/fragments/video-message/VideoMessage.tsx) — removed the now-unused `roomMediaItems` fallback; chat taps open the viewer with `[event]`.

Flow: gallery grid loads 10 → user taps thumbnail → viewer uses the same live store → swiping toward older reveals the loader → pagination adds 10 more → repeats until `reachedEnd`.
